title: Pharmacy: GLP-1 receptor agonists for chronic weight management
service_name: GLP-1 receptor agonist for chronic weight management

supported_diagnoses.E66.01: Morbid (severe) obesity due to excess calories
supported_diagnoses.E66.09: Other obesity due to excess calories

criteria.text: The member is 18 years of age or older.
Baseline BMI is 30 kg/m2 or higher, or 27 kg/m2 or higher with at least one weight-related comorbidity (hypertension, type 2 diabetes, dyslipidemia, or obstructive sleep apnea).
The member has taken part in a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity program for at least 3 months before the request, and will continue it during treatment.
The drug will not be used together with another GLP-1 receptor agonist or GLP-1 containing product.

sections.heading: Scope and plan applicability
sections.text: This policy applies to GLP-1 receptor agonists prescribed for chronic weight management in adults. In this synthetic benefit design it applies to commercial PPO and HMO plans only. Use for type 2 diabetes is reviewed under a separate diabetes policy.

sections.heading: BMI and comorbidities (criterion C2)
sections.text: Use a BMI measured within the last 3 months, before treatment. When the BMI is between 27 and 30, at least one weight-related comorbidity must be documented as a diagnosis: hypertension, type 2 diabetes, dyslipidemia, or obstructive sleep apnea. Prediabetes alone is not a qualifying comorbidity in this policy.

sections.heading: Lifestyle program (criterion C3)
sections.text: The record must describe a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity for at least 3 months, for example a dietitian program, a structured commercial program, or clinician-supervised counseling with documented follow-up. A single counseling visit or a statement that the member was advised to lose weight does not meet the criterion.

sections.heading: Concurrent therapy (criterion C4)
sections.text: GLP-1 receptor agonists must not be combined with each other or with GLP-1 containing combination products. If the member currently takes another GLP-1 product, the request must state that it will be stopped.

sections.heading: Renewal
sections.text: Initial approval is for 6 months. Renewal requires at least 5 percent weight loss from baseline. Renewal is outside the scope of the initial review.
